accents.$description: The accent axis (port-manifest §8.4), dark resolution. Six user-selectable accents; indigo is the default. On the desktop these become :root[data-accent="…"] blocks; on Android they become CopyPasteAccent entries fed to the Material 3 ColorScheme.

accent-2.$description: Lighter accent for on-dark emphasis text (SAS digits, links).

on-accent.$description: Dark ink: the teal fill is too light for white text at AA.
Dark ink: the green fill is too light for white text at AA.
Dark ink: the amber fill is too light for white text at AA.

accent.$description: The active accent. Defaults to indigo; the desktop overrides it per [data-accent], Android per CopyPasteAccent.

accent-2.$description: The active accent's lighter ramp step.
